question: Identify the misspelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Antideluvian'.**

 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Antediluvian'.**
 
• The word '**Antediluvian**' is an **adjective** which means 'extremely old-fashioned or outdated'. **(अत्यंत पुराना या प्राचीन)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• Their antediluvian belief
